json_output_instruction: Return only a compact JSON object with one key, choice, whose value is the letter of the best option. Example format: {"choice":"A"}
joint_output_instruction: Return only one compact JSON object. Use each field name exactly once as a key and its selected option letter as the value. Do not include explanations or additional keys.
array_output_instruction: Return only a compact JSON array of option letters, with exactly one letter for each field in the order listed above. Do not include field names, explanations, or additional elements.
